annotations.title: China Subject 1 Bilingual Question Bank Search (2,545 Official Items)

description: Filter the full 2,545-question Mainland China driving theory exam corpus by English or Chinese keyword, topic chapter, difficulty rating, and historical candidate error rate.

chapterSlug.description: Filter by one of the 9 official Subject 1 syllabus chapters or pass "all".

keyword.description: Search phrase matched against English/Chinese prompts, answer options, or legal explanations (e.g., "yellow", "alcohol", "expressway").

limit.description: Maximum questions returned per query (1 to 25, defaults to 10).

minDifficulty.description: Minimum difficulty tier from 1 (basic) to 5 (high-trap tricky wording).

questionType.description: Restrict results to 4-option multiple choice or Correct/Wrong true-false judgement questions.

sortByErrorRate.description: Sort matching items descending by historical candidate error rate to surface top exam traps first.
